title: A notification-setting change is recorded with who and when
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag). Open the audit trail wherever the build surfaces it for the asset/customer and check entries against the action you just performed.
  2. A customer whose "Maintenance notifications" setting you can change, and the case where a shop asserts the customer's consent on their behalf.
custom_steps:
1. Change a customer's notification setting and open the audit trail; read who made it and when.
  2. Assert the customer's consent on their behalf and confirm a name and date are recorded against it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A change to a customer's notification setting is recorded with who made it and when.
  • A shop asserting a customer's consent on their behalf is recorded with a name and a date against it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10576 (S21, The audit trail); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S21; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S21-R7: “A change to a customer's notification setting is recorded with who made it and when. A shop asserting a customer's consent on their behalf is the one thing that later needs a name and a date against it”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on a Maintenance Reminders QA build (feature ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag)
